# Rule 10 — Exploits, bugs, multikeying, ban evasion, and New Life Rule
Do not abuse bugs, exploits, unintended mechanics, or broken systems. If you find a serious bug, report it to staff instead of using it for an advantage.
Do not intentionally crash the server, lag the server, bypass restrictions, duplicate items, access areas through unintended methods, or use mechanics in ways that clearly break the game.
Multikeying is not allowed. Do not use multiple accounts, characters, or connections to gain an advantage, bypass consequences, scout information, or interfere with an active round.
Project Verdant uses a New Life Rule. You may rejoin the same round as a new character after death or cryo, but your new character has no memory of your previous character’s life, death, enemies, discoveries, or round information.
Your new character may not return to your previous death location to recover items, continue a fight, search for the person who killed you, expose antagonists, warn others with information from your previous life, or otherwise act on knowledge your new character could not have.
Ban evasion is forbidden. If you are banned, do not use another account, VPN, proxy, or alternate connection to bypass the ban. Appeal through the proper channels instead.
If you accidentally trigger a bug or exploit, stop using it and report it as soon as possible.
